description: Verify a numeric claim against its cited source (geoa's Gate). Fetches the source page and checks mechanically whether the number appears there and whether the source is circular; with a geoa account it also checks SEMANTICALLY whether the source actually supports the claim. Returns a verdict: supported | unsupported | self_referential | unverifiable, plus the matched evidence.

claim.description: The claim containing the number, e.g. '68% of searches end without a click'

source_url.description: URL of the source the claim cites

name: geoa_verify_claim
title: Verify Claim Against Source
